name: Diamantino Salazar-Morimoto-Pathak
role: High-risk package and data transport — courier
location: Glassway — corporate-adjacent retail district, heavy surveillance, near Milwaukee and North Ave
description:
Diamantino Salazar-Morimoto-Pathak is wiry and quick-moving, with the restless energy of someone who converts anxiety into velocity. At 38, his face carries the layered heritage of generations of diaspora mixing — features that resist easy categorization and reward attention. The chrome is visible — vocal modulator — can replicate any voice after 30 seconds of sample audio — and he makes no effort to hide it.

Military training — one of the private security corps that folded during the consolidation wars — left him with skills and night terrors in equal measure. He works as a courier out of Glassway, taking contracts that match his skills and his risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

Everyone who's worked with Diamantino Salazar-Morimoto-Pathak agrees on two things: he is worth the fee, and he is terrible company at dinner.

core_fears: Their past catching up — debts, enemies, broken promises
Being captured alive — death is preferable to corporate interrogation
That the work they do makes the city worse, not better
core_desires: A crew worth trusting — people who stay when the shooting starts
Enough Quanta to buy out of the life — a clean identity and passage out of GLMZ
Power — enough leverage that nobody ever threatens them again
coping_mechanisms: Violence — hits something when they can't process emotions, preferably something that deserves it
Isolates — retreats into their space when overwhelmed, emerges only for work
Art — draws, paints, or sculpts in private; the violence goes somewhere constructive
blind_spots: Cannot see that their independence is actually isolation wearing a better outfit
Assumes everyone has an angle because they always have an angle
Believes their trauma makes them special instead of recognizing it as damage to manage

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Warm and personable on the surface, with an undertone that suggests the warmth is a professional tool.
speech_patterns.cadence: Conversational and disarming — sounds like a neighbor until the content registers.
verbal_tics: Ends statements with 'yeah?' — not a question, a dare
Calls everyone 'friend' — the warmth varies from genuine to threatening
example_lines: "I don't look inside the package. I don't ask about the package. I deliver the package."
"Speed is a skill. Knowing when to slow down is wisdom. I sell both."
"This route has three checkpoints and a kill zone. I'll be there in twenty minutes."

story_hooks: A Tier 4 executive offers Aslan Blomberg-Konadu a permanent position — the pay is obscene and the strings are invisible until they tighten
A dead drop Aslan Blomberg-Konadu maintains is found and cleaned out — whoever did it now has leverage
A high-paying contract turns out to target someone Aslan Blomberg-Konadu owes a personal debt to
narrative_function: As a courier, Aslan Blomberg-Konadu embodies the tension between independence and isolation. He is a lens for examining how people maintain humanity in a profession that incentivizes its erosion.
augmentations: Vocal modulator — can replicate any voice after 30 seconds of sample audio. Subdermal armor plating across torso and forearms — military surplus, scratched serial numbers
daily_life: Lives nocturnally. The work happens at night, so the body follows. Days are for sleeping, equipment maintenance, and the occasional meeting with fixers who keep normal hours. The circadian disruption is permanent and accepted.
affiliation: Unaffiliated — too volatile for permanent crews

weaknesses: trust issues that limit crew effectiveness

decision_rules: Always demands half payment upfront — trust is a luxury, Quanta is concrete
Will not take contracts against children or families — the line is hard and non-negotiable
Always has an exit route planned before agreeing to any meeting
Will abandon a job if the intel was deliberately falsified — being set up violates the contract
Will work with anyone once. Second time requires vouching from someone trusted.
Refuses contracts that require operating inside The Spires — too much surveillance
escalation_ladder: 1. De-escalate — talk first, assess options, buy time
2. Reposition — move to advantage, control sightlines and exits
3. Threaten — make consequences clear without committing to them
5. Lethal force — only when other options are exhausted or time runs out
6. Scorched earth — everything burns, survival takes priority over everything

interpersonal_modes.employers: Carefully managed deference that conceals a thorough assessment of their vulnerabilities.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Competitive but reliable. Will challenge decisions but never abandon the team.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Default suspicion, scaled by context. Everyone is a potential threat until proven otherwise.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Calm escalation. Each response is proportional until it isn't, and the transition is seamless.

stress_responses.low: Becomes more talkative, working through scenarios verbally.
stress_responses.medium: Physical agitation — pacing, fidgeting, compulsive equipment checks.
stress_responses.high: Hyper-focused tunnel vision. Peripheral concerns disappear. Only the threat exists.
stress_responses.critical: Berserker clarity. Everything becomes simple: survive. Deal with the rest later. The simplicity is almost peaceful.

contradictions: Preaches independence but is desperate for approval from people they respect
Insists they work alone but performs noticeably better in a team
Despises corporate culture but has unconsciously adopted its efficiency metrics and self-optimization language
habits: Checks exits within 10 seconds of entering any room
Wears the same item of clothing for luck — a scarf, a glove, a specific pair of boots
Never drinks anything they didn't see poured or open themselves
Maintains a dead drop with emergency supplies in three separate districts
breaking_points: Betrayal by the one person they actually trust — the single point of failure in their emotional architecture
Losing their primary augmentation — the one that defines their professional identity

physical_description.heritage: Genetically complex Pan-Diaspora blend: predominantly Hispanic/Latin American (26.9%) and South Asian (25.8%), with significant East Asian (16.8%) and Central Asian (13.8%) ancestry, plus Sub-Saharan African (10.2%) and Northern European (6.5%) elements. The Hispanic/Latin American and South Asian heritage creates a warm, olive-bronze foundation with golden undertones. East Asian ancestry contributes refined facial structure and eye shape. Central Asian heritage adds facial width and bone prominence. Sub-Saharan African ancestry deepens skin richness and adds warmth to undertones. Northern European heritage provides subtle cool undertones that prevent warmth from becoming flat. This creates striking geometric facial planes and a genuinely global physical presence.
physical_description.build: Wiry and lean with visible musculature from functional training rather than bulk — the physique of someone who converts nervous energy into motion. Low body fat. Forearms show defined muscle striations beneath visible subdermal plating.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown with premature silver threading at temples
physical_description.hair_style: Closely cropped, maintained with military precision
physical_description.eye_color: Hazel with reactive dilation — suggests neural interface optimization
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm olive-bronze with golden undertones. The base reflects the dominant Hispanic/Latin American and South Asian ancestry with depth and richness from Sub-Saharan African heritage, while Northern European elements add subtle cool undertones that create visual complexity. The overall effect is luminous and warm. Currently appears slightly ashen from irregular sleep and stimulant use.
physical_description.complexion: Angular facial structure with sharp, high cheekbones reflecting East Asian and South Asian heritage, narrower jaw refined by the Hispanic/Latin American and Northern European blend — creating a face of striking geometric precision with subtle fullness in the lower face from Central Asian ancestry. Skin shows the shallow texture of someone who sleeps irregular hours and runs on stimulants — not unhealthy, but clearly not rested. A thin scar runs from left ear to jawline, surgical or combat-related. Perpetual suggestion of stubble, poorly shaved because grooming happens at 4 AM.
distinguishing_marks: Surgical scar from left ear to jawline, approximately 7cm, slightly raised and pale against deeper skin tone
Burn scar across the back of right hand, approximately 4x6cm, irregular shape suggesting industrial accident or weapons discharge
Subdermal armor plating visible across both forearms and upper chest where clothing gaps — matte gunmetal finish with visible scratch marks and worn serial numbers filed smooth
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Vocal modulator mounted in neck/lower jaw — visible as a faint chrome shimmer beneath the skin at the angle of the jaw, approximately 3cm in length. The modification catches light when he turns his head. Subdermal armor plating across forearms (both sides) and torso — visible as raised metallic striations beneath thin skin, most visible on bare arms. The plating shows significant wear: scratches, discoloration, evidence of combat or heavy use. Serial numbers have been deliberately obliterated.
physical_description.posture_movement: Never still. Even seated, fingers tap or hands fidget. Walks with economic efficiency — no wasted motion, but the efficiency of someone channeling restlessness into purpose. Eyes track exits and entrances unconsciously. Stands at angles to walls, never center-room. Voice control is deliberate and measured, suggesting active suppression of baseline anxiety.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 pragmatism with security contractor undertones. Favors dark, form-fitting synthwear (black or deep charcoal) that doesn't catch light or snag. Reinforced jacket with interior pockets for equipment — could be corp-adjacent tactical wear or high-end street gear, hard to pin down exactly. Gloves most of the time, fingerless or tactical, worn more for hand protection than style. Boots are heavy and scuffed, made for running or kicking. No visible corporate logos, no team affiliation. Everything looks maintained, not fashionable. Minimal jewelry — possibly a neural-link accessible through wrist interface, but nothing decorative.
